svg.title: Планка с подъёмом ноги — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. One full-body side view of an isometric forearm plank with one leg raised. Elbows and both forearms contact floor, elbows under shoulders, torso and supporting leg in a straight line, one toe contacts floor. Other leg is straight and lifted slightly above hip line, no bent knee, no movement of arms. Two clearly distinct feet and legs, no arching and no furniture. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
